name: Weaponized Spell
body:
While in your weapon form you can cast spells.

Prerequisite(s): Arma, Inherent Magics, Character level 5th, ability to cast spells

Benefit(s): While in weapon form you may cast spells without their verbal and somatic components and you may even use any material components or focuses you possess, even though such items are melded within your current form. Spells cast in this manner take one action type greater than normal (a swift becomes a standard, a standard becomes a full round, etc.) spells with a casting time of more than one full round action cannot be cast in this manner. Spells cast in this manner do not provoke attacks of opportunity.
